name: Just Compensation
label: Quest
description: Just Compensation: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux. I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin. Bring me an ordinary belt and a set of gloves that you wish to upgrade.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You're ready to perform the trade?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've kept your end of the bargain, I shall keep mine.
Just remember that I'm holding on to the best pieces until your work is finished.
